nodes.label: Controller-Service-Model architecture pattern
nodes.rationale: Fully implemented in TypeScript to ensure data consistency and developer productivity.

nodes.label: CSS variable-based theme engine (Light Renaissance / Dark Blue Archive)
nodes.rationale: CSS-variable theming in src/index.css enables seamless switching between a paper-like 'Renaissance' light mode and a 'Blue Archive' dark mode optimized for low-light readability.
nodes.norm_label: css variable-based theme engine (light renaissance / dark blue archive)

nodes.label: Feature-based frontend directory structure
nodes.rationale: Organizing by feature (features/catasto/) rather than by type is intended to ensure scalability as the app grows.

nodes.label: Multi-container Docker deployment architecture
nodes.rationale: Perché due immagini separate?: separate frontend (Nginx static), backend (Node API) and database (MySQL) images/containers are used to maximize cleanliness and isolation of services.

nodes.label: Monorepo architecture
nodes.rationale: Centralizes shared types/interfaces in @catasto/shared and unifies dev/build tooling from the repo root to keep frontend and backend in sync.
